content:
alice: quick preflight — onboarding olivia-v1. weights uploaded to gs://redwood-models/olivia-v1/weights.tar.gz, tokenizer in gs://redwood-models/olivia-v1/tokenizer.json. noticing extra EOS when using our chat template; sample streaming trace attached.

ben: ran quick tokenize smoke: different behavior when including system sentinel
ben: command i used:
```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('User: hi', add_special_tokens=True).ids)"
```

deploy-bot: weights upload finished — gs://redwood-models/olivia-v1/weights.tar.gz (12.3GB) :white_check_mark:

dmitri: likely sentinel mapping mismatch. model expects '<|assistant|>' as bos but our chat-template inserts assistant start token. can you paste the tokenizer.special_tokens_map?

carol: quick config diff:
```json
{"bos_token":"<|assistant|>", "eos_token":"</s>", "add_prefix_space":false}
```

ben: i toggled trim_eos=true in runtime config and ran a short canary — streaming no longer appends extra EOS. posting patch in CR.

alice: plan: 1) verify special token ids via token id lookup 2) update chat template to not double-insert bos 3) run full qc job (ben) 4) infra validate mount (eve)

eve: mounted weights on canary gpu pool, created symlink at /models/olivia-v1 -> /mnt/weights/olivia-v1

ben: quick test script i pushed to repo:
```python
# scripts/token_check.py
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('gs://redwood-models/olivia-v1/tokenizer/')
print('ids', t('User: hi', add_special_tokens=True)['input_ids'])
```

alice: thanks — if tests pass, we'll do a canary rollout tomorrow morning. @dmitri can you review the CR?

dmitri: on it, will comment by EOD :eyes:

alice: adding note to onboarding checklist and tickets: #INF-2217, #ML-1422

carol: also flagged backward-compat for older chat templates — added to doc

alice: resolving async for now. feel free to re-open if you hit anything during canary.

:thumbsup:
